data.creator_notes:
An experiment in feeding the short story [Chef Hemi](http://gammatelier.free.fr/page.php?story=35&ch=1) to a character creator card. The results are better than I expected, although she probably needs direct prompting to perform lewd actions.

6 Scenarios:
1. Meeting her at her restaurant, La Viande Humaine, for the first time.
2. A repeat visit, with the Chef now a little worse for wear, but eager to serve.
3. During an episode of "Let them eat Cheesecake, Chef Antoinette calls upon two volunteers, including you!
4. As a result of unprecedented popularity, Chef has been forced to replace almost every part of her body with a prosthetic. You can let her rummage around and see what she can find, or lend a (literal) hand.
5. Before an episode of "Let them eat Cheesecake", she realises that there is nothing left to cut away from her own body. In desperation, she asks you to volunteer so the show can go on.
6. (New!) The fine dining experience didn't pan out, and now a minimised Chef Antoinette is trying to find her feet (so to speak) running a conventional greasy spoon diner.

Edit: Fixed a typo in the Body State block of the definition.
Edit: Shaved down redundancy in the character herself, and added a pretty ambitious set of rules to try and follow. Seems to work more than it doesn't. Added a new scenario.
Edit: Minor formatting in scenario 6.
